# Open3DPP

> Open data standard for FFF/FDM polymer printing. A flat characterization
> schema: one row = one observation of a material — a settings card
> (recommended conditions), a measured specimen (geometry + mechanical
> properties), or a moisture response (a fitted property-vs-moisture relation).
> 152 columns in 8 blocks, each with a name, type, unit and purpose.

Maintained by Sunnyday Technologies LLC. Apache-2.0. Draft v0.1.0 — a community
specification, not a standards-body publication, and not a certification.

## Canonical documents
- Repository (authoritative): https://github.com/sunnyday-technologies/Open3DPP
- Core JSON Schema: https://open3dpp.org/schemas/core/v0.1.0/open3dpp-record.schema.json
- Field reference (152 columns): https://open3dpp.org/FIELDS.md
- Schema reference: https://open3dpp.org/Open3DPP_SCHEMA.md
- Changelog: https://open3dpp.org/CHANGELOG.md
- Applied-System Addendum: https://open3dpp.org/ADDENDUM.md
- Crosswalk from Cura / OFD / Orca / Prusa: https://open3dpp.org/CROSSWALK.md
- Format research: https://github.com/sunnyday-technologies/Open3DPP/blob/main/research/cura-fdm-material-census/report.md

## Applied-System Addendum
Linked sidecars for the applied context a core record deliberately excludes —
equipment, environment, measurement method, external artifacts. Each references
a core record and versions independently; a core record is complete without one.
- https://open3dpp.org/schemas/addendum/v0.1.0/applied-system-context.schema.json
- https://open3dpp.org/schemas/addendum/v0.1.0/artifact-timeseries-manifest.schema.json
- https://open3dpp.org/schemas/addendum/v0.1.0/measurement-outcome-bundle.schema.json

## Contributing
Anyone can propose a field or a correction through GitHub issues; no affiliation
is required. See CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository.

## How to use it
Validate a record against the schema whose version equals the record's own
`schema_version`. Schemas are closed and version-exact by design; there is no
`latest` alias, because a moving pointer would break every pinned consumer.

## What it is not
Not printing or engineering advice. Not a materials database — it hosts no
product data, recommends no settings and ranks no products. Vendor claims
(certifications, safety trait tags, drying limits, hardware requirements) are
recorded exactly as published and are never verified.
